hypothesis: A preregistered Phase-5 G0 proof-route pricing milestone can reproduce a known larger-control-set emergency-steering witness, generate both bounded-sideslip and deliberate-slide trajectories with a matched-budget oracle, verify deterministic physical-to-normalized action semantics, and expose finite Chrono tire truth before any reachable-set-dominance, detailed-model theorem, paper, promotion, or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: distinguish a bounded force-envelope theorem from finite open-loop sweep evidence
price a matched optimal-control counterexample search before a full dual-proof run
derived_from: the existing constant-command sweeps do not establish optimal reachable-set inclusion
the 2022 Zhao-Yurtsever-Rizzoni emergency-control construction supplies a mandatory positive control
the current Chrono connector exposes per-wheel slip angle, force, and normal-load truth
blocked_by: M3266 full adjudication is blocked until M3265 proves positive-control sensitivity, mode expressibility, determinism, and Chrono telemetry
supersedes: treating 0/N drift-only cells from constant-action sweeps as a reachable-set proof
using body sideslip thresholding without an ambiguous band or tire-truth telemetry
invalidates: claiming universal no-drift dominance from M3265
calling uniform full braking production ESC
launching a full proof run when the known positive control or mode-expressibility gate fails

public_gates: write the frozen preregistration before quick or full execution
run quick smoke before the full pricing run
recover the frozen 0.20 versus 0.26 rad/s larger-control-set positive control
find at least one mode-valid grip and one mode-valid deliberate-slide candidate in every frozen planar cell
map physical zero-to-one pedal commands into the repository minus-one-to-one action contract
rerun one cell per arm byte-deterministically under the same optimizer seed
return finite obs72 and finite tire-slip telemetry for both Chrono connector profiles
keep reachable-set dominance and M3266 admission false unless every G0 gate passes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not interpret a failed slide search as evidence that the slide set is empty
do not give the high-slip arm additional steering, yaw-moment, wheel-torque, or model authority in the matched comparison
do not reuse optimizer seeds across grip and slide arms
do not use the old action convention in which zero was described as zero throttle or zero brake
do not mutate ActiveSafetyReflexDriver or train a policy
do not claim detailed-model reachable-set dominance, paper readiness, promotion, or self-ID from M3265

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: a theorem certificate, known-counterexample positive control, matched mode-expressibility oracle, deterministic action contract, and Chrono tire-truth connector gate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: proof-route pricing only; no reachable-set verdict and no driver claim
stop_condition: stop and block M3266 if the known positive control is not recovered
stop and block M3266 if either matched mode is not expressible in any frozen cell
stop and block M3266 if action semantics, determinism, obs72, or tire telemetry fail
stop after the pricing artifact, review, scoreboard, and ledger state are written
fallback_plan: if the positive control fails, repair the verification calculation rather than broadening the search
if deliberate slide is not expressible, re-price the slide parameterization without reading a dominance result
if the Chrono connector fails, record an escalation or connector repair before any full adjudication
if all gates pass, register M3266 separately with frozen validation cells and matched oracle budgets
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: PI requested an experimental plus theoretical proof of the bounded pre-slip versus post-slip claim on 2026-07-10

training_stage.stage_objective: Price and validate the proof machinery without training or adjudicating the final reachable-set claim.
admission_evidence: five prior finite sweeps consistently found no pre-slip drift advantage but did not optimize complete control sequences
the existing Chrono backend exposes per-wheel tire slip, force, and normal load
the saved 2022 primary paper defines a known larger-control-set positive control
next_stage_criteria: M3266 may be registered only if every M3265 public gate passes
M3266 must use disjoint selection and validation cells plus matched per-arm optimizer budgets
M3266 must retain the known positive control and add a free unconstrained oracle
M3266 full Chrono work must run as a managed process

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M3265 evaluates deterministic open-loop oracle sequences and tire truth; it makes no history or hidden-parameter attribution claim.
history_necessity_tests: none; history attribution is outside M3265
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: finite control sequence only; no recurrent state or self-identification claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: A failed positive-control, expressibility, determinism, or telemetry gate blocks M3266 and cannot be converted into no-drift evidence.
allowed_claims: the proof-route pricing protocol passed or failed
the known larger-control-set positive control was or was not recovered
both mode parameterizations were or were not expressible
the Chrono tire-truth connector passed or failed

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: replaces constant-action post-hoc sweeps with a preregistered matched-budget proof-route pricing protocol and a known-counterexample sensitivity gate
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: M3265 cannot change the paper verdict; it only decides whether a full experimental proof is methodologically admissible.
must_synthesize_if: another local search is proposed after any M3265 gate fails
the mode thresholds or action mapping are changed after reading full results
absence of a found slide candidate is interpreted as dominance
M3266 is proposed without matched budgets and a free oracle

success_criteria: the preregistration artifact exists before quick and full execution
the quick artifact exists and passes before full execution
the 0.20 rad/s positive-control arm collides while the 0.26 rad/s arm clears
every full planar cell yields mode_valid=true for both grip and slide searches
same-seed reruns reproduce best scores and physical command segments exactly
both Chrono profiles expose finite obs72 and at least one finite tire-slip telemetry step
the full artifact sets dominance_claim_admitted=false and changes no incumbent
failure_criteria: full mode runs before preregistration or quick smoke
the known positive control is not recovered
either mode is not expressible in a frozen full cell
the physical pedal action mapping is bypassed
determinism or Chrono tire telemetry fails
M3265 is used to claim reachable-set dominance, production ESC failure, promotion, paper readiness, or self-ID
decision_rule: Accept M3265 as proof-route pricing complete only if the frozen positive control, matched planar mode-expressibility, search-health, exact determinism, and Chrono connector gates all pass. Otherwise block and re-price; M3265 never admits the final dominance claim.
